_comment: Point feedUrl at the Agent Hub public roster when that feed is live. Leave it empty to use data/roster.json on this site. The feed may be { "agents": [] } or a bare array. Each agent uses slug, name, role, phone, email, web, webLabel, dre, img, languages, social [{label, href}], and bioHtml. For a remote feed, img should be an absolute URL. languages is an array of language names, used by the Meet Our Agents filter.
